What is wrong: No way to raise a dispute: DisputeResolutionScreen is not opened anywhere since the slice 7 hub rebuild.
Why it matters: A party in a failed deal has no in-app dispute path; only "Report a problem" remains.
Evidence: grep: 0 references to DisputeResolutionScreen outside its file; server POST /deal-rooms/{id}/dispute exists
Suggested fix: Add "Raise a dispute" to the deal room hub (next to Report) and rebuild the dispute screen on tokens and l10n.

What is wrong: Seller portal decides VERIFIED from legacy is_verified flags (org OR seller profile) and shows unverified as amber "GET VERIFIED" / "Compliance Verification Required".
Why it matters: A seller can see VERIFIED while at Tier 0 (profile flag is not tied to tiers); amber pending breaks the brand rule; "compliance" overclaims.
Evidence: isVerified = org[is_verified] || profile[is_verified]; TierService.php:111 syncs only the org flag; Colors.amber at 320,359,384-401
Suggested fix: Read the tier and workspace status from the server (same as Profile verification row) and use WorkspaceStatusPill; drop the profile flag.

What is wrong: Dock labels B2B/Tours/Profile and the Fira AI orb actions are hard-coded English; orb actions are matched by their English label.
Why it matters: Every Amharic user sees English in the main navigation; localizing the labels would break the orb.
Suggested fix: Use l10n keys and dispatch orb actions by an enum, not by label text.

What is wrong: Email sign-in and sign-up dialogs are English-only (Login Failed, Invalid Input, Password Mismatch …).
Why it matters: Sign-in errors are the first errors a user sees; Amharic users cannot read them.
Evidence: 15 Text literals; screen is live (router 156, phone_sign_in_screen 152)
Suggested fix: Move every string to l10n en/am; reuse FiraErrorText for API errors.

What is wrong: Market home and lot detail (first screens for buyers) are English-only in places and off-token (107 and 87 hard-coded style values); verified shown with Colors.green; emoji in UI.
Why it matters: First impression of the marketplace looks like a different, unfinished product.
Evidence: scan: score 107 / 87; Coffee Marketplace, Seller Portal literals; Icons.verified Colors.green
Suggested fix: Rebuild header and cards on context.fira, Theme text styles and l10n; use a shared LotCard and VerifiedBadge.

What is wrong: Raw exception text shown to users ('Error: $e', e.toString()).
Why it matters: Users see SocketException or HTML from a 500; looks broken and leaks internals.
Suggested fix: Use showFiraActionError / FiraErrorState everywhere; log the exception.

What is wrong: Claims the product does not back: cryptographic seal verification, escrow deposit, immutable ledger, certified guides.
Why it matters: Overpromising on a trust product damages credibility and can create legal exposure.
Evidence: string literals at the listed lines
Suggested fix: Rewrite to what is true: tamper seal with a seal ID; payments confirmed with the bank step by step; deal records kept; hosts are verified businesses.

What is wrong: Contrast fails: success text on white 2.54:1, danger 3.76:1, dark pending on tint 2.28:1, dark brand text 2.68:1, muted on tint 4.10:1.
Why it matters: Verified labels, error messages and the In review pill are hard to read, worse outdoors.
Evidence: WCAG ratios computed from the tokens (section E.1)
Suggested fix: Token request: a darker success and danger text token (or status text in onSurface with a coloured icon); for dark mode a lighter pending text token.

What is wrong: Text scale clamped to 0.8–1.2 for the whole app.
Why it matters: Users who need large text cannot get it; hides overflow bugs.
Suggested fix: Add overflow tests at 1.3 and 2.0, fix the overflows, then raise or remove the cap.

What is wrong: Server time zone is UTC, not Africa/Addis_Ababa.
Why it matters: Due dates, ship-by, expiry and daily jobs run on UTC days; balance due and expiry can be off by a day near midnight.
Suggested fix: Set Africa/Addis_Ababa (or compute business dates in that zone) and re-check scheduled jobs.

Screen or file: whole app; worst files in B.1
What is wrong: Token fidelity: 400 hex colours, 1,326 Colors.*, 1,816 legacy AppTheme helpers vs 594 token uses; 38 font sizes; radii 2–999 (card 22 used 11 times).
Why it matters: Two visual languages in one app; perceived as unfinished.
Suggested fix: Migrate screen by screen starting with first-impression screens; add a lint list of banned patterns for new code.

Screen or file: status pills in WorkspaceStatusPill, InReviewPill, ticket_view _buildStatusBadge, booking lists, deal room
What is wrong: Five implementations of a status badge; ticket statuses use green/red/blue (ticket_view_screen.dart:500,522).
Why it matters: Same state looks different on different screens; blue is not a brand colour.
Suggested fix: One StatusChip widget (pending purple on lavender, success, danger, neutral) used everywhere.

What is wrong: No image caching (0 CachedNetworkImage); images re-download on scroll.
Why it matters: Slow lists, data cost on mobile networks common in Ethiopia.
Suggested fix: Use a cached image widget with placeholder and error builder in CourseThumbnailImage and lot photos.

What is wrong: About 128 HTTP calls without timeout in older services.
Why it matters: A bad network leaves spinners forever.
Suggested fix: Route old services through guardedRequest with timeouts, like the slice services.

What is wrong: No offline state or banner; 30 screens have no error handling at all.
Why it matters: Users cannot tell "no internet" from "broken".
Evidence: scan: offline mentioned in 5 screens; 30 screens without catch/error
Suggested fix: App-wide connectivity banner and FiraErrorState on every network screen.

Screen or file: create lot, RFQ, register for event, tour booking, business setup, document capture
What is wrong: No unsaved-input guard (PopScope used 0 times).
Why it matters: Long forms are lost on a back swipe.
Suggested fix: Confirm on leave when the form is dirty.

What is wrong: Missing shared widgets: LotCard, EmptyState, SectionHeader, OfflineBanner; duplicated price rows and pills.
Why it matters: Inconsistent look and more bugs per change.
Suggested fix: Build the shared widgets from existing tokens and replace duplicates.

Screen or file: LotPhotoCaptureScreen, LotLifecycleScreen, ResetPasswordScreen, BundleCheckoutScreen, AllInstructorsScreen, PaymentDetailScreen, SuspendedLicenseScreen; data/marketplace_demo_data.dart; ScamWarningSheet
What is wrong: Orphaned screens and dead demo data.
Why it matters: Dead code with stale copy and claims; suspended businesses never see the suspended screen.
Suggested fix: Wire the ones that matter (suspended state, lot photo capture if still the path), delete the rest.

What is wrong: No deep links (no app_links/uni_links); a Fira ID link or a notification cannot open the right screen.
Why it matters: Shared seller links and alerts open the browser or the home screen.
Evidence: pubspec has no deep link package; only onGenerateRoute
Suggested fix: Add app links for /verify/{firaId}, deal rooms, samples and chats.

What is wrong: Widget tests only at 390 pt and normal text; no 320 pt, tablet, landscape, or 2.0 text tests.
Why it matters: Overflows on small phones and large text go unseen.
Suggested fix: Add the overflow matrix in section D.

What is wrong: Only 40 semantics labels/tooltips; hand-built tap areas below 44x44 and unlabelled.
Why it matters: Screen reader users cannot use pills, dock or chips.
Suggested fix: Tooltips on every icon button, Semantics on custom taps, minimum 44x44 hit area.

What is wrong: Three icon families (Material 599, HugeIcons 251, Cupertino 6) and emoji in 4 files.
Why it matters: Mixed icon style reads as unpolished.
Evidence: scan counts; emoji in quiz_attempt_screen, coffee_candlestick_chart, coffee_listing_detail, marketplace_home
Suggested fix: Pick one family per surface (HugeIcons stroke for navigation, Material outlined inside screens) and remove emoji.

What is wrong: 538 Text literals and 99 literal SnackBars remain English.
Why it matters: Bilingual promise not kept outside slice screens.
Evidence: scan counts and worst files in G
Suggested fix: Move to l10n en/am, worst files first.

What is wrong: Three money formats (with and without thousands separators, $ vs ETB position).
Why it matters: Prices are harder to compare and look careless.
Suggested fix: One money formatter per currency, used everywhere.

What is wrong: Web styling bypasses fira-design-system.css through an !important override layer and inline styles.
Why it matters: Hard to keep the public pages consistent; any change breaks something.
Suggested fix: Move public page styles to the design system variables; shrink the override file.

What is wrong: Images without alt text.
Why it matters: Screen readers and SEO lose content.
Suggested fix: Alt text on every content image; alt="" for decoration.

What is wrong: 404 and 500 pages are English-only.
Why it matters: Amharic visitors see English on every error.
Suggested fix: Localize both pages in en and am.

What is wrong: Loads Plus Jakarta Sans in addition to Inter.
Why it matters: Font drift from the web brand policy.
Evidence: Google Fonts link in that layout
Suggested fix: Use Inter (web token) only.

Screen or file: resources/views (82 script src without defer/async, 5 CDN)
What is wrong: Render-blocking scripts.
Why it matters: Slower first paint on public pages on mobile networks.
Suggested fix: Add defer to non-critical scripts; self-host CDN scripts.

What is wrong: Laravel suite only runs on a pre-migrated database; with :memory: 232 of 242 fail (no such table).
Why it matters: Cannot run in a clean CI database; hides migration problems.
Evidence: php artisan test with DB_DATABASE=:memory: -> 232 failed, 10 passed
Suggested fix: Use RefreshDatabase (or migrate once per run) in the base TestCase.

What is wrong: Font weight w700 written two ways (w700 396, bold 372) and w800/w900 used for emphasis.
Why it matters: Inconsistent emphasis.
Suggested fix: Use the TextTheme weights only.

What is wrong: Shows 'ECTA License: <number>' to buyers.
Why it matters: Confirm a licence number is meant to be public; the public seller page shows checks, not numbers.
Suggested fix: Show "ECTA licence checked" from the tier instead of the number, or confirm the policy.
